crossRefs.note: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,
that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will…
“I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.
Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.
I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,
About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

translations.web: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.
translations.bsb: With many such parables Jesus spoke the word to them, to the extent that they could understand.
translations.kjv: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear
translations.asv: And with many such parables spake he the word unto them, as they were able to hear it;
